objections.objection: You ask us to agree a platform today, but I see no budget, no fee figure and no split. I cannot judge value or commit to anything without a cost.
objections.slide: Investment, and what we would like to agree today

change.note: Supply the agency's fee, production and media figures from the rate card, for at least option A, so the client can see what is being asked for.

objections.objection: Your own proposition slide says we should not believe this insight yet, yet you ask me to approve the platform built on it today.
objections.slide: Young adults may know tea well but not think of it for summer, so Fernley can make tea the cold, sparkling choice. This must be confirmed.

change.note: Is the agency asking for approval of the platform today, or approval after the audience interviews confirm the insight? Which one, and why?

objections.objection: You show no team names and no past work with results. I cannot trust you to deliver when nobody is named and no referee is offered.
objections.slide: The team you would work with, and work like this we have done

change.note: Supply named people with one-page CVs for each role, plus two real comparable campaigns with results and a referee.

objections.objection: Awareness and trial have no targets and no dates. I cannot tell what success looks like or when you would be judged against it.

change.note: What awareness and trial targets, among 18 to 34 year olds, will the agency propose, and by when in the 2027 flight? The client may need to agree them.

objections.objection: I see an idea line but no channels, no media plan and no sense of how 'Tea's day out' reaches 18 to 34 year olds across spring to summer.

change.note: Which channels and executions will carry the idea, and what is the phasing from spring to summer 2027?

objections.objection: The alcohol-cue risk is raised, but the fix leaves legal codes to us. I need to know which rules apply to an audience starting at 18.
objections.slide: Risks: an untested insight and no baseline, and what we would do about them

change.note: Which advertising codes does the agency believe apply, and who confirms them before creative development?
